correctness.rationale: Use rung alphabet {E,U,L}; transfer T has eigenvalues a=1+sqrt2, b=1-sqrt2 and -1, giving Z_n=a^n+b^n+(-1)^n. Sum/difference occupation diagonal insertions decompose into even and odd rail sectors. The exact cyclic sums of a^h b^{n-h} and signed odd-sector cross-terms produce lambda+ and lambda- including the exceptional k=0 term n(eps Z-1)/(8 Z^2). The positive-probability empty set and every singleton force covariance positive definite for each n. Uniform a^-n remainder and mesh endpoints yield asymptotic f+(cos)=sqrt2/[4(3+cos)] and f-(cos)=1/[4(sqrt2+cos)], hence ratio 4+2sqrt2. Independently enumerated all valid rung strings for n=3..7 (counts 13,35,81,199,477), matching both formulas within numerical rounding; infinite n comes from exact transfer proof.
residual_risks: Finite n extremal frequency indices are not classified; large n fixed fugacity only.
